summary: Progress toward a U.S.-Iran ceasefire sent equities to fresh records this week, with the S&P 500 advancing to 7,365, as oil prices retreated sharply on de-escalation hopes. April payrolls came in at 115,000, nearly double Wall Street's 60,000 estimate, marking back-to-back months of six-figure job growth and removing near-term pressure on the Fed to cut rates.
tweet: Iran ceasefire hopes crushed oil prices while a blowout April jobs report kept the Fed on hold — stocks hit records but bonds and gold are caught in the crossfire.
